subject: Post-demo recap & procurement path for NovaMed
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@novamed.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: rajesh.p@novamed.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for the demo — next steps and procurement questions

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. The team found the latency/cost tradeoffs compelling and we liked the autoscaling examples you showed. Two quick asks as we align internally: 

1) Who is the economic buyer we should loop in (title/name)? Our procurement team wants to know the approver for commitments > $100k/yr.
2) What vendor onboarding materials do you typically need (SOC 2, vendor intake form, SOW, DPA)?
3) Can you give a rough lead time for a private deployment (VPC) + dedicated capacity? We are targeting service in production by the end of Q4.

Also copying Rajesh (IT security) — he’ll likely drive the security questionnaire.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Li
Director of Data Platforms | NovaMed
Samantha.Li@novamed.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@novamed.com>
Cc: rajesh.p@novamed.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — next steps and procurement questions

Hi Samantha —

Great to hear — glad the demo was useful. Quick answers and next steps below: 

- Economic buyer: typically the Head of Engineering or VP of Data for customers of your size. If you can share names I’ll reach out; otherwise suggest we include your VP Eng in the next sync.

- Vendor docs we commonly provide: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), a standard DPA, our vendor onboarding form, and a draft SOW. I’ve attached the vendor onboarding form so your procurement team can preview required fields.

- Private deployment timeline: for a standard VPC + dedicated pool we usually see 6–8 weeks from contract signature for initial capacity and access (longer if you require on-prem air-gapped installs). We can fast-track certain items if procurement and security align on the checklist.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll introduce Ben (SE) and Jonas (accounts ops) on thread — they’ll own technical questions and billing/PO logistics respectively.
2) Can your team confirm a billing contact and desired PO terms (Net 30/Net 45)?
3) Rajesh — I’ll send the SOC 2 and DPA links immediately; any particular questionnaire format you prefer (e.g., SIG, CAIQ)?

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for looping me in. Two items from my side: 

- I’ve attached a procurement checklist (procurement_checklist.xlsx) that maps out the typical docs and decision owners we see: budget approval, security attestation, vendor intake, SOW, PO issuance, and billing details. It includes example SLAs and a templated PO amount that aligns with the config we demoed.

- Billing contact and invoice flow: we bill via AP department by default (invoices@novamed-ap.com is ideal). Jonas — can you confirm Redwood’s AP team email and typical PO references we should include on invoices?

If it helps, I can produce a short one-page executive summary tied to cost-per-1M tokens to present to your VP Eng/Finance.

Thanks — this is helpful. Quick responses: 

- Billing contact: accounts-payable@novamed.com (Net 30 is preferred; please include PO number on all invoices).
- Economic buyer: looping in Maria Chen, VP Engineering (maria.chen@novamed.com) — she will review the exec summary and sign off on budget.
- Security: Rajesh prefers the SIG questionnaire; I’ve attached our internal intake template for reference. We will require SOC 2 Type II and a signed DPA before legal will escalate to contract.

We received the onboarding form and checklist — we’ll return the completed onboarding form this week. For timing: if we can get the SOW and DPA signed in August, we can target a September start for initial provisioning and go-live in late Q4. Is that timeline realistic on your side?
